gloss: to say definitively; to declare; to assert

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {言|い}い{切|き}りませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {言|い}い{切|き}っていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {言|い}い{切|き}っていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to say definitively; to declare; to assert
definitions.explanation: To state something with complete certainty and conviction, leaving no room for doubt or hedging.

definitions.gloss: to finish saying; to say completely
definitions.explanation: To complete what one was saying without being interrupted or stopping midway.

examples.japanese: ⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧{言|い}い{切|き}った。

examples.english: I can't say for certain that it's safe.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{絶対|ぜったい}に→絶対に：08722_zettaini⟧⟦{成功|せいこう}する→成功する：21445_seikousuru⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{切|き}った。
examples.english: He declared with certainty, "I will definitely succeed."

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{言|い}い{切|き}れない。
examples.english: I can't say for certain that she's the culprit.

examples.japanese: ⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧「⟦{間違|まちが}いない→間違いない：17813_machigainai⟧」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{切|き}れる⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{少|すく}ない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: Few people can confidently declare, "There's no mistake."

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{言|い}い{切|き}った。
examples.english: I said everything I needed to say.

examples.japanese: ⟦{話|はなし}→話：01496_hanashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{切|き}る⟦{前|まえ}に→前に：00965_maeni⟧⟦{遮|さえぎ}られた→遮る：10876_saegiru⟧。
examples.english: I was interrupted before I could finish speaking.

examples.japanese: {言|い}い{切|き}らない⟦うちに→うちに：28396_uchini⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}→電話：01471_denwa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{切|き}れた→切れる：01936_kireru⟧。
examples.english: The call was disconnected before I could finish what I was saying.

examples.japanese: ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{言|い}い{切|き}って⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{次|つぎ}に→次に：30273_tsugini⟧⟦{進|すす}みましょう→進む：01225_susumu⟧。
examples.english: Let's finish saying the sentence before moving on.

examples.japanese: ⟦{緊張|きんちょう}→緊張：02494_kinchou⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦スピーチ→スピーチ：03852_supiichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧{言|い}い{切|き}れなかった。
examples.english: I was so nervous that I couldn't finish my speech.

notes:
- {言|い}い{切|き}る → {言|い}い{切|き}らない (negative)
- {言|い}い{切|き}る → {言|い}い{切|き}って (te-form)
- {言|い}い{切|き}る → {言|い}い{切|き}った (past)

FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{言|い}う→言う：00515_iu⟧ (to say) + ⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ (completely)

The ～⟦{切|き}る→切る：02693_kiru⟧ pattern indicates doing something completely or with conviction.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{言|い}い{切|き}る - to declare that...
- {言|い}い{切|き}れない - cannot say for certain (very common negative form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{断言|だんげん}→断言：12916_dangen⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧{言|い}い{切|き}る - to assert categorically
- ⟦はっきり→はっきり：01228_hakkiri⟧{言|い}い{切|き}る - to state clearly
- ⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧{言|い}い{切|き}る - to state with confidence

USAGE:
The negative form 「{言|い}い{切|き}れない」 is especially common for expressing uncertainty or hedging statements.
